rdfs:label: generator
rdfs:comment: The application that generated the object — typically a software client or service.
notes: ActivityStreams' "created with" attribution. Upstream range is as:Object | as:Link; usually an Application — the value is typically the client app (e.g. a Mastodon instance, a Solid app). Distinct from `urn:solid:wasGeneratedBy` (PROV-grade activity attribution): generator names *what software*, wasGeneratedBy names *what process run*.

examples.title: Note generated by a client app

history.note: Dropped too-narrow rdfs:range Application (upstream Object|Link); example uses as:name instead of urn:solid:name (foaf:name).
